note: Goliad County publishes no zoning layer; Texas counties generally do not zone, and the assessor's site says county zoning maps are not available. The City of Goliad zones its land (AG, R-1, R-2, C-1, I-1, MU, FP, H districts per Chapter 14, Zoning Ordinance 2021), but its only zoning map is a PDF (City Zoning Map, Oct 13 2021) and the ordinance is text on ecode360. No queryable ArcGIS/WFS/download zoning polygons were found for the county or city in ArcGIS Hub/Online searches.
